title: Submultiplicative Polynomials in Combinatorics
summary: For normalized sequences $\left(g(n)\right)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ we consider recursively defined polynomials $P_n^g(x)$. In this paper we study their submultiplicative property, viewed as a Bessenrodt--Ono type inequality for the partition function, and provide an effective criterion for establishing it.
